result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual inconsistency is in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where card images are misaligned. There are also a few minor contrast and styling concerns.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a taller image that starts higher (about y=631) than the Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria cards (about y=658). The images differ in height, so the time badges, titles and delivery-fee text sit at different vertical positions and the row looks misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel card images the same fixed height and aspect ratio, and align the cards to the top so titles and metadata line up on one baseline.

issues.description: The first carousel card has a pale, washed-out background. Its white time badge ('15–25 min') blends into it and has little separation, unlike the badges on the dark images.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or border to the badge, or use a consistent image treatment or overlay across cards.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the '€0.90 delivery' lines, the search placeholder and the inactive tab labels is light gray on white or light gray. Contrast is low and the text may be hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) buttons are styled inconsistently. The ramen card's heart has no background, while the pizza card's heart sits on a dark translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent style for the favorite button, such as a translucent circular background on every card.
